selection: contiguous 50 percent loss, linear repair; all five training seeds for full MIRA and each of three component controls
calculation: For each training seed, subtract control macro F1 from full-MIRA macro F1 after the existing five-mask average. Summary uses arithmetic mean, sample SD (ddof=1), and strict positive/negative/zero counts across the five paired differences.
estimator_note: Each underlying training/mask score pools 1260 held recordings across all three folds; neither probabilities nor fold F1 scores are averaged to obtain pooled F1.
scope: Descriptive variation over five fixed training seeds. These are not confidence intervals or independent participant samples and do not establish a guarantee over future retraining.
participant_interval_distinction: The existing participant-bootstrap intervals condition on the fitted seed grid and do not include retraining uncertainty. They were not recalculated or modified.
